name: CogniFace
description: Wajah kecil yang ngikutin kursor, berkedip, dan ekspresinya ikut harimu. Kalau ada lagu, ia ngangguk ikut irama. Ia kaget kalau kursor ada di atas notch atau ada notifikasi. Klik biar boing.
descriptionEn: A little face that follows your cursor, blinks, and reacts to your day. It nods to music, jumps when your cursor is over the notch or a notification arrives, and boings when clicked.
